derivation: noisy.wav: a 440 Hz sine of amplitude 0.5 (RMS 0.5/sqrt(2) = -9.03 dBFS) on for the first 0.5 s of every second, white noise uniform in [-0.01, 0.01] (RMS 0.01/sqrt(3) = -44.77 dBFS) throughout. 50 ms windows align with the 0.5 s bursts, so half the 80 windows are noise only (p10 = the noise RMS) and half are tone + noise (p95 = the tone RMS; the noise adds < 0.001 dB). SNR = -9.03 - (-44.77) = 35.74 dB
